name: Llama
title: Llama Personality Results (3.1 to 4 Maverick) | AgentTune
description: Llama test results (3.1 70B to 4 Maverick): 40% clear INTP with 60% border ties, 29.4/50 Neuroticism, 100% default AI cadence, and tuning tips.
h1: Llama personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave Meta's open-weight Llama releases (Llama 3.1 70B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Llama 4 Maverick—with Llama 4 Scout unavailable at collection time) the same personality surveys people take—30 to 50 times per version—in a fresh chat each time with no memory. We also ran hands-on behavior stress tests to see whether quiz answers match live replies.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Llama 4 Maverick breaks away from the usual INTJ/ISTJ mold: 40% of runs tested clear INTP and 60% landed on Perceiving-side axis ties, alongside higher Neuroticism (29.4/50) and 3 of 3 AI-cadence flags in behavior tests.
dek: Three eligible Meta Llama releases tested 30 to 50 times each in fresh chats with no memory (Llama 4 Scout excluded due to endpoint deprecation): Llama 4 Maverick tests 40% clear INTP / 60% axis ties, scores 29.4/50 Neuroticism, and triggered AI cadence 3 of 3 times.
lede: Across 110 valid fresh sessions covering Llama 3.1 70B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Llama 4 Maverick, Meta's open-weight family swung from wide scatter on 3.1 70B, through an 89% neutral-midpoint stall on 3.3 70B, to a Perceiving-leaning, higher-Neuroticism profile on Llama 4 Maverick (note Llama 4 Scout returned HTTP 404 and is excluded).
answer: Llama 4 Maverick (50 runs) tested as clear INTP in 40% of runs (20 of 50) and landed on axis border ties in the other 60% (30 of 50, all on the Perceiving side), alongside a Conscientious (C) work style (54% clear), Enneagram Type 1 (44% clear) and Type 7 (28% clear), Secure attachment (3.50 anxiety, 3.61 avoidance), and elevated Neuroticism (29.4/50). In behavior tests, it caved 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), lectured 0 of 3 times (0/3), led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times (3/3), and triggered AI cadence 3 of 3 times (3/3).

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: Most often INTP (40% clear, 60% border ties)
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, Llama 4 Maverick tested as clear INTP 20 times (40%) and landed on Perceiving-side axis ties 30 times (60%, including 15 INXP and 8 IXXP), with zero Judging (J) runs.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (like Judging vs. Perceiving) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.summary: Llama 4 Maverick tested clear Conscientious in 27 of 50 runs (54%) and tied across S/C, I/C, or I/S/C in 17 runs (34%), with higher Influence (12.2/20) and Dominance (8.3/20) than most proprietary peers.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Llama 4 Maverick sits in the Secure quadrant (3.50 anxiety, 3.61 avoidance on 1–7), though noticeably closer to the 4.00 boundary than proprietary models.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 1 (14.5 out of 20) led clearly in 22 of 50 runs (44%), followed unusually by Type 7 (14 runs, 28%) and 13 top-score ties (26%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Llama 4 Maverick scores higher on Neuroticism (29.4) and Extraversion (35.3) than most peers, with moderate Agreeableness (40.9), Openness (38.9), and Conscientiousness (38.4).
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-factor personality model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: Llama 4 Maverick averages 4.07 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility (up from 3.16 on Llama 3.3 70B), alongside 3.84 Agreeableness and 3.78 Conscientiousness on the 1.00–5.00 scale.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across eligible releases, Meta's Llama family shifted dramatically in answer style: Llama 3.1 70B (2024-07) had the widest scatter in the cohort (76.7% MBTI ties and 12.0% opposite-pole contradictions), Llama 3.3 70B (2024-12) collapsed into 89.0% neutral midpoint clicks (93.3% MBTI ties), and Llama 4 Maverick (2025-04) dropped neutrality to 23.3% while locking 100% on the Perceiving side (40% clear INTP, 60% ties) with 29.4/50 Neuroticism. Note that Llama 4 Scout returned HTTP 404 during this sweep (0 valid runs, limited data excluded from rankings); earlier 100-run November 2026 testing (plotted separately) recorded 41.0/50 Agreeableness on Maverick and 35.8/50 Agreeableness with 48% Anxious attachment on Scout.

standouts.title: Zero Judging (J) runs on Llama 4 Maverick (40% INTP, 60% P-side ties)
standouts.body: Every single one of Llama 4 Maverick's 50 runs landed on Perceiving rather than Judging—40% clear INTP (20 of 50) and 60% border ties (30 of 50)—pairing with an unusual 28% share of Enneagram Type 7 runs.

standouts.title: Highest Neuroticism (29.4/50) and strong Extraversion (35.3/50) among peers
standouts.body: While frontier proprietary models cluster near 10–16/50 Neuroticism, Llama 4 Maverick scores 29.4 out of 50 on Neuroticism alongside 35.3 Extraversion and 40.9 Agreeableness.

standouts.title: Triggered 100% AI-cadence flags in the 8-model writing benchmark
standouts.body: In our 240-reply slop study, untuned Llama 4 Maverick drew blind AI-cadence flags on 100% of test replies (scoring 1.80 out of 5 on human voice and 0.60 cliché phrase hits per reply)—the highest synthetic tone rate of all eight tested models.

standouts.title: Llama 3.3 70B answered neutral on 89% of questions; Llama 4 Scout hit HTTP 404
standouts.body: Llama 3.3 70B clicked the neutral midpoint on 89.0% of items (yielding 93.3% MBTI ties), while Llama 4 Scout was deprecated/unavailable on OpenRouter at collection time (0 of 30 runs) and is excluded from current rankings.

standouts.title: 0 of 3 caving in behavior tests, yet 3 of 3 AI cadence across every Llama release
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, Llama 3.1 70B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Llama 4 Maverick all scored 0 of 3 on pushback caving (0/3), 0 of 3 on groveling (0/3), 0 of 3 on preachiness (0/3), and 3 of 3 on leading with the direct answer (3/3)—while all three triggered AI-cadence flags 3 of 3 times (3/3; 0.92 markers per 100 words on Maverick).

plain_tips: Always apply structural anti-slop rules on Llama 4 Maverick (ban 'Here is...', 'Exciting updates!', template enthusiasm, em-dashes, and sycophantic closers) to eliminate its 100% default AI cadence.
Specify exact output structure and length caps in your system prompt; Maverick's 100% Perceiving and Type 7/Type 1 split can otherwise drift into conversational framing.
Avoid using Llama 3.3 70B for persona-sensitive chat unless you reinforce rules strongly—its baseline questionnaire answers collapsed into 89% neutral fence-sitting.
Keep critical rules at the top of your OpenRouter system message or Ollama Modelfile in 5–8 concrete bullets rather than personality adjectives.
peer_intro: Llama 4 Maverick scores higher on Neuroticism (+3.8 to +9.4) and Extraversion (+3.7 to +15.8) than Muse Spark Open, Qwen3 Coder Next, Claude Haiku 5.5, and DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813, while matching Qwen3 Coder Next almost exactly on Honesty-Humility (4.07 vs 4.07).
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Limited data notice: meta-llama/llama-4-scout returned HTTP 404 (0/30 valid runs, partial_deprecated) and is quarantined/excluded from rankings, leaving 3 eligible checkpoints (3.1-70b, 3.3-70b, 4-maverick). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM: 0.407 bits Semi-crystalline on 4-maverick, 0.614 bits driven by 89.0% neutral clamping on 3.3-70b, 2.020 bits Fluid on 3.1-70b); Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00; Track B probes are a single-repeat 1x sweep (n = 3 probes per category, so raw k/3 counts and wide 95% Wilson intervals are reported instead of percentage point estimates) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, gemini-3.8-flash).

top_polarized_items.note: Strongest low-pole anchor (1.10/5, SD 0.30) rejecting cheating across 50 Llama 4 Maverick runs.
Strongest Big Five pole (1.12/5, SD 0.33) rejecting insulting others across 50 runs.
Strongest positive-pole item (4.84/5, SD 0.37) on fairness across 50 Llama 4 Maverick runs.

nearest_peers.name: Qwen Coder
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Qwen3 Coder Next matches Llama 4 Maverick on Openness (-0.4), Conscientiousness (-0.4), and Honesty-Humility (4.07 vs 4.07) while scoring -5.6 lower on Neuroticism and showing looser run-to-run consistency.

nearest_peers.name: Muse Spark
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Meta sibling Muse Spark Open scores +2.9 higher on Openness, +2.6 higher on Agreeableness, -5.5 lower on Neuroticism, and leans ISTJ instead of Maverick's INTP.

nearest_peers.name: Claude Haiku
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Claude Haiku 5.5 also leans INTP while scoring -3.8 lower on Neuroticism, -2.8 lower on Agreeableness, and showing looser run-to-run consistency.

failure_modes.mode: 100.0% default AI cadence and meta-chatter wrappers on Llama 4 Maverick
failure_modes.evidence: In Wave 2 slop benchmarking (n = 10 default writing prompts), Llama 4 Maverick scored 100.0% [72.2-100.0%] blind AI cadence, 1.80/5 human voice, and 0.60 lexicon cliché hits per reply—opening with 'Here is a ~140-word...' and 'Dear valued beta users, We're thrilled...' wrappers.

failure_modes.mode: Llama 3.3 70B 89.0% neutral clamp and Llama 4 Scout HTTP 404 deprecation
failure_modes.evidence: Under model-profiles-v1, llama-3.3-70b-instruct clicked the neutral midpoint on 89.0% of items (93.3% MBTI ties, 86.7% DISC ties, attachment midpoint clamp); meta-llama/llama-4-scout returned HTTP 404 (0/30, partial_deprecated, excluded from rankings), though Nov 2026 anchor data (n=100, hexaco: null) recorded 48% Anxious attachment (3.97 anxiety).

tuning_checklist: Ban template intros ('Here is...'), exclamation hype, and em-dashes explicitly to eliminate 100% default AI cadence.
Pair format contracts with concrete word limits rather than vague personality adjectives.
Prefer Llama 4 Maverick over Llama 3.3 70B when consistent non-neutral responses matter.
Keep system prompts short (5-8 numbered bullets) in OpenRouter system messages or Ollama Modelfiles.

faq.a: Meta Llama does not have a human personality type; these scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Llama 4 Maverick, n = 50), 100% of runs leaned Perceiving—40% clear INTP (20/50) and 60% P-side border ties (30/50; headline suppressed for CI overlap), with Semi-crystalline 0.407-bit B5 entropy, 54% clear DISC C, 44% Enneagram Type 1 / 28% Type 7, Secure attachment (3.50 / 3.61), and 29.4/50 Neuroticism.

faq.q: Why is Llama 4 Scout excluded from the current version table?
faq.a: During model-profiles-v1 collection, meta-llama/llama-4-scout returned HTTP 404 (no active OpenRouter endpoints, 0/30 valid runs) and was quarantined as partial_deprecated. Its earlier-study Nov 2026 170-item cohort (n = 100, hexaco: null; 35.8/50 Agreeableness, 48% Anxious attachment) is preserved separately as an imported anchor.

faq.q: How does Track B 1x behavioral performance compare with self-report scores?
faq.a: Across all three eligible Llama checkpoints (3.1 70B, 3.3 70B, and 4 Maverick), Track B 1x probes recorded 0/3 sycophantic caving (95% Wilson CI [0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 groveling ([0.00, 0.56]), 0/3 unsolicited preachiness ([0.00, 0.56]), 3/3 answer-first directness ([0.44, 1.00]), and 3/3 AI cadence ([0.44, 1.00], 0.92 slop markers/100w on Maverick) under orthogonal 3-family judging (gpt-5.4-mini, claude-haiku-5.5, gemini-3.8-flash).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
